description: This file defines an interface 'ProductPriceService' for managing product prices within the sales manager system. It extends a generic service interface and provides methods for adding descriptions to product prices and saving or updating product price entities.

classes.name: ProductPriceService
classes.description: An interface that extends generic service functionalities for product price entities, providing methods for description management and persistence.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a specified product price, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists or updates the given product price entity, may throw a ServiceException.
